title: Designated-Waste (Jijeong-Paegimul) Manifest Chain-of-Custody Record
description: Evidence model for the cradle-to-grave electronic manifest ( - ) chain-of-custody record for designated waste (Jijeong-Paegimul /  ) transported off-site from a generator facility to a licensed treatment or disposal facility. The manifest captures generator, transporter, and receiver licensing; waste classification; net weight; and 3-way signature block. Distinct from the designated-waste chemical-treatment PROCESS record (which governs on-site neutralization/solidification chemistry under CCA Art 23); this record governs the REGULATORY CHAIN-OF-CUSTODY for transport off-site under WCA Art 25 licensing. Required by Korea's ALLBARO electronic-manifest system ( -  ) overseen by the Ministry of Environment.

manifest_tracking_number.description: Korea ALLBARO system electronic-manifest tracking number ( ) issued by the Ministry of Environment for the designated-waste shipment.

waste_category_code.description: Korea designated-waste category code per WCA Enforcement Rule Schedule 1 (e.g., ' ' waste-organic-solvent, ' ' waste-acid, ' ' waste-alkali, ' ' waste-oil, ' ' designated-infectious-waste, ' ' dust-treatment-residue).

generator_license_id.description: WCA Art 25 generator-facility license number ( -  ). The facility that generated and is releasing the designated waste.

transporter_license_id.description: WCA Art 25 waste-transporter license number ( -  ). The licensed carrier moving the waste off-site.

receiver_license_id.description: WCA Art 25 treatment/disposal facility license number ( -  ). The licensed facility that receives, treats, or disposes of the waste.

net_weight_kg.description: Net weight of the designated-waste shipment (kilograms). Must reconcile against weighbridge tickets at generator exit and receiver entry within tolerance.

pickup_timestamp_iso.description: Pickup timestamp at the generator facility (ISO 8601). Driver must confirm correspondence to the receiver-delivery timestamp to close the manifest.

chain_of_custody_signed.description: True if the 3-way signature block (generator + transporter + receiver) is complete, confirming cradle-to-grave custody with no gap. Required to close the ALLBARO manifest within the regulatory period.

cca_chemical_accident_prevention_plan_re.description: Reference to the CCA Art 23 Chemical Accident Prevention Management Plan ( ) under which the designated-waste shipment is managed, when the waste class is a CCA-regulated hazardous chemical.
